title: From client brief to clear quotation to portfolio

say: From client brief, to clear quotation, to portfolio.
This is the video for module four of Interior Decoration Basics: client brief, quotation and your decorating business.
A weak brief causes most disputes. I said modern, not this. A strong brief makes every later decision easier.

say: Ask the client to send two or three photos of the room by WhatsApp. For your safety, tell someone where you are going and when you expect to finish, especially when visiting a new client alone.

say: At the visit, ask what the room is for, who uses it, what they dislike now, and which items must stay.

panel.heading: Running the client brief

say: Ask about style, colours, budget and timeline. When a client says modern or cosy, ask her to point to a picture, because those words mean different things to different people. If she is shy about budget, offer ranges.

panel.heading: Running the client brief
items: Ask for room photos before the visit

say: If the client rents, check that the landlord allows painting or drilling.

panel.heading: Running the client brief
items: Ask for room photos before the visit

say: After the visit, type the brief in short points and send it: please confirm this is correct. Keep the reply. If the client later asks for a second room, treat it as a change request with its own price and timeline.

panel.rule: Extra work outside the brief is a change request, priced in writing.

say: Write the scope: what is included, and what is not, such as electrical work by the client's electrician.

say: Say the quote is valid for 14 days, because prices change.

say: Ask for a deposit before you buy materials, and confirm it in your bank app, not by SMS alert, before you shop.

say: And state that extra work is quoted separately and approved in writing. If the total is over budget, do not just cut your fee. Offer a cheaper fabric, a feature wall, or doing the work in phases.

say: Build three to six projects, each with the brief in two lines, before and after pairs, and the colour scheme. A floor plan or mood board shows you plan properly. Decorating a relative's parlour or a church office for photos and a testimonial counts.

say: To remember. Confirm the brief in writing. Put your fee on its own line. Add materials, labour, transport, fee and contingency. Take the deposit first and confirm it in your bank app. And show only real work and real testimonials.

say: Now practise. Run a practice brief with a friend and make a mood board. Write a full quotation with real prices, 10% contingency and terms. Then launch your portfolio and your WhatsApp Business profile, and complete your capstone.
